en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into three adjacent panels within a simple decorative border. The left panel shows a modest Gothic‑style church with pointed arched windows and a tall slender spire, standing beside another brick building, with bare trees and a low fence in front. The central panel depicts a substantial two‑story brick house with shutters on the windows, set behind a hedge and small gate along a roadside lined with leafless trees. The right panel shows another large brick house with a tiled, fairly steep roof and many windows; several children in light‑colored clothing stand or walk along the road in front of the hedge. The scene appears to be a quiet village or small‑town street in winter or early spring.
